placeholder.label: Mustering an expedition: early morning on the strand below the home village, three ships with gangplanks down, men carrying barrels, sacks, spears and shields aboard. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

The expedition comes home: from the leading ship's deck, the ships rowing up the fjord low in the water, the whole village running down to the strand. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.

The expedition is lost: a handful of soaked survivors walking home along a grey shore road in the rain, without their ships, the home village small ahead. Subject on the right two thirds; the left third stays calm for text.
